title: Scalar change commutes with the compactification pullback compositor
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings and φ:A→B a unital homomorphism. For schemes X,Y, a map f:X→Y, a compactification c=(j:X→Z,g:Z→Y,f=j;g), and K∈D_A(Y), write Q for ordinary derived scalar extension, a_p:Q;L_B(p)≅L_A(p);Q for scalarPullbackIso and k_R:L_R(g);L_R(j)≅L_R(f) for leftDerivedUpperStarCompactificationIso. Then Q_X(k_A(K));a_f(K)⁻¹ = a_j(L_A(g)K)⁻¹;L_B(j)(a_g(K)⁻¹);k_B(Q_Y K). This is an equality of morphisms from Q_X(L_A(j)L_A(g)K) to L_B(f)Q_Y K. There are no flatness, finiteness or boundedness hypotheses.

proof.text: Apply scalarPullback_composition to c.i and c.g, with output map f and factorization c.comm. Use the proved private categorical transport_composition helper: precompose the exact composition equation by the B exact/left-derived comparison for f and postcompose by scalar extension of the inverse comparisons for c.g and c.i. Naturality of the comparisons and scalarPullbackIso cancels the inverse pairs, giving the forward composition square for the left-derived pullbacks.

Expand leftDerivedUpperStarComp via leftDerivedFunctorNatIso and leftDerivedFunctorCompIso; the comparison for the composite exact functor cancels with its inverse. This identifies the transported compositors in the square. Regard both sides as composite object isomorphisms, use Iso.ext, and take their inverses. The proved source-library leftDerivedUpperStarCompactificationIso_eq identifies the compactification compositor with the inverse general compositor indexed by f and c.comm, yielding the displayed formula without substituting in the dependent compactification data. Only functoriality, naturality, and inverse cancellation are used, so zero objects and empty schemes are included.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarPullback_compactification
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    (scalarExtension φ X).map
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarCompactificationIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).hom.app K) ≫
      (scalarPullbackIso φ f).inv.app K =
    (scalarPullbackIso φ c.i).inv.app
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K) ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) c.i).leftDerivedFunctor.map
        ((scalarPullbackIso φ c.g).inv.app K) ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarCompactificationIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) c).hom.app
        ((scalarExtension φ Y).obj K)
